welcome.title: Nielsen's 10 Heuristics
welcome.subtitle: Experience what good and bad UI design feels like — hands on. You'll complete 10 pairs of tasks, each designed to show one heuristic being respected and violated. A narrator will guide you through every step.

good.method1Desc: Use an app like Google Authenticator to generate time-based codes.
good.method1Tooltip: Most secure option. Works offline. Compatible with all 2FA apps.
good.method2Desc: Receive a one-time code via SMS each time you log in.
good.method2Tooltip: Convenient but less secure than an authenticator app.
good.method3Desc: Use a physical key (e.g. YubiKey) for the strongest protection.
good.method3Tooltip: Best security, but requires purchasing a physical device.
